name: Jumble
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: fingerguns83
description: Randomly change blocks in your hotbar.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Key R (held, polled each tick) turns Jumble mode on or off ('Jumble Mode Enabled' / 'Jumble Mode Disabled' in the action bar); while on, each block placed switches the selection to a random hotbar slot holding a block.
note: Not yet: The random slot switch after placing a block is not checked: the random slot can be the one already selected, and it needs the client's UseBlockCallback.
